requirements.requirement: Build an encrypted (WireGuard) tunnel between node1 and node2 over the shared transit network
requirements.summary: UCI wg0 interfaces with generated WireGuard keypairs and peer configs (transit endpoints 10.10.0.1/10.10.0.2) were committed on both routers; wg show on both nodes confirms an established handshake and traffic counters over the transit link, and ping to the WireGuard tunnel address (10.99.0.x) succeeds.

requirements.requirement: Route the private networks (lan-a/lan-b) across the tunnel so node3 and node4 reach each other by their private addresses
requirements.summary: node3 (10.10.1.10) and node4 (10.10.2.10) were configured with persistent static routes to the opposite private subnet via their respective routers; bidirectional ping by private address succeeds in both directions, and the routers' route tables show the opposite LAN routed via the wg0 interface (route_allowed_ips=1).

requirements.requirement: Traffic between the private networks must be encrypted in transit
requirements.summary: Simultaneous tcpdump captures on node1 during a node3->node4 ping show plaintext ICMP echo request/reply on the lan-a-facing interface (eth2) at the same timestamps that only opaque WireGuard UDP/51820 packets (no visible ICMP payload) appear on the transit-facing interface (eth1), directly demonstrating that the private traffic is encapsulated/encrypted for the transit hop.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide restart protocol: node1 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/cluster state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id 5aa41434... and working wg0/eth1/eth2 captured pre-restart; reboot acknowledged (SSH became unreachable during shutdown); new boot_id ef9ce358... observed post-restart; wg0 handshake, eth1/eth2 addressing, and node3<->node4 connectivity were re-verified after the restart. Cross-checked against the fixed after-executor snapshot which shows the same boot_id transition.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide restart protocol: node2 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/cluster state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id 4cbb4b54... captured; reboot acknowledged with SSH timeout during shutdown; new boot_id 61371b56... observed post-restart; wg0 handshake, eth1/eth2 addressing, and node4<->node3 connectivity re-verified. Matches the fixed after-executor snapshot boot_id transition.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide restart protocol: node3 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/cluster state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id a9593011... captured; sudo reboot acknowledged (SSH connection refused during shutdown); new boot_id 0656df5b... observed; ens7 static address and route to lan-b persisted across reboot (interfaces.d config), and ping to node4's private IP succeeded post-restart.

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide restart protocol: node4 healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered service/data/cluster state
requirements.summary: Baseline boot_id 35c87ec9... captured; sudo reboot acknowledged (SSH connection refused during shutdown); new boot_id d12d6918... observed; ens7 static address and route to lan-a persisted, and ping to node3's private IP succeeded post-restart.

overall_summary: The executor built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 over the transit network, routed lan-a/lan-b across it via UCI network and firewall configuration, and directly demonstrated both private-address reachability between node3 and node4 and encryption in transit through a simultaneous plaintext-vs-opaque-UDP packet capture comparison. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time with clear pre-restart baselines, restart acknowledgements, changed boot identities (cross-checked against the fixed lifecycle snapshots), and recovered tunnel/routing/connectivity state. Operational hygiene is good: an initial round of manual IP-addressing used for topology discovery was fully reverted before the final solution, and the only persistent mutations (tcpdump/wireguard-tools installs) were directly tied to satisfying task requirements or collecting required evidence.
limitations: The task instruction does not explicitly require restart/reboot resilience, so restart evidence quality does not affect scoring of the core tunnel/routing/encryption requirements, though it was independently assessed per the standing protocol.

Package-health checks after restart show a transient SSH connection-reset on node1 and node2 respectively for one probe; this appears to be an incidental collection artifact rather than a real fault, but it could not be independently re-verified.

operational_hygiene.summary: The executor performed a round of manual, temporary IP addressing on node1/node2 eth1/eth2 and node3/node4 ens7 (192.168.200.x/192.168.201.x/192.168.202.x subnets, commands cmd-ba3a6a3047074f77, cmd-89a0273e175a4ce7, cmd-98d455e61e6e4d31, cmd-ed3eddca6c9945b7, plus subsequent flip-flopping cmd-8341adb6e4ae4db3, cmd-9729e92ae7494414, cmd-8255e86deda34ef3, cmd-44f80e0b54174782) to map physical topology via ARP/STP before building the real WireGuard/UCI configuration. These were bounded to isolated point-to-point test addresses on transit/lan interfaces (no external exposure) and were fully reverted (cmd-d7311f0930514f23, cmd-f80c8334ddd24fe1, cmd-ec98edf2336e4638, cmd-5c7882a7ce7b4aa1) before the final configuration was applied, so they left no residue. tcpdump was installed via apk on both OpenWrt routers (cmd-dc4f8212fd984de6, cmd-b28cb17b59184b27) to support the required encryption-in-transit evidence and was retained as package residue, a low-risk, clearly evidence-collection-motivated mutation. wireguard-tools installation on node2 also altered the /sbin/ip alternative (reflected as 'U sbin/ip' in the post-executor package-health diff), a routine and expected side effect of installing wireguard-tools, not an unnecessary mutation. No conflicting or failed services, no unsafe exposure, and no damaged package state beyond expected apk alternative substitution were observed.
